newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers fuel oil dip, gas oil rises.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers fuel oil dip, gas oil rises.

text.p: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers dipped on Tuesday in response to barge market weakness, but gas oil prices in European ports picked up despite Tuesday's weakness on futures, dealers said.
Rotterdam bunkers were quoted as low as $86 fob, mostly by majors, while barges were offered at $85 ex wharf. Independent suppliers offered nearer $87 fob.
Total ARA volume was just over 10,000 tonnes.
Hamburg prices were broadly stable. Shipowners were reluctant to buy.
Mediterranean fuel oil bunkers were steady.
Gas oil rose by $2. Demand in most places was poor.
In Fujairah, benchmark quotes came down by $2, but offers were at most $1 a tonne weaker with some shipowners needing to buy.
